recipes.name: Toasted Coconut & Almond Granola
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F / 160°C*. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the oats, almonds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, coconut, and salt.
Add the maple syrup and oil, and mix well to coat everything evenly. Spread the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for about 30 minutes, or until lightly golden. Stir twice during baking to ensure even toasting.
Let cool completely on the baking sheet. The granola will continue to crisp up as it cools. Once cooled, stir in any add-ins you like**. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** If adding chocolate, be sure the granola is completely cool to prevent it from melting.
Storage Store sealed and on the counter for up to 3 weeks.
